summary: BUG FIX VERIFIED: Wallet (Portafoglio) render crash 'Property user doesn't exist' at portafoglio.tsx:62 is resolved. ClientWallet now correctly destructures `const { user } = useAuth()` at line 27 and renders without any red-screen error. Verified 3 scenarios: (1) Client with bonus_credit=0 (disp-test-token-777) — wallet loads fully, bonus card correctly HIDDEN, borsellino/limiti/attivita blocks render. (2) Client with bonus_credit=25.50 (via /api/auth/me route interception) — bonus card renders with correct amount €25.50 and gift icon, no crash. (3) Provider regression (provtest@jobby.app / test1234) — ProviderDashboard opens without crash, shows earnings/limits/reliability blocks. Frontend testing only, as requested.
